title: Output schema of TikTok Scraper
description: TikTok Scraper stores scraped posts in the default dataset. Each item contains post ID, caption text, author info, engagement stats (likes, views, replies, reposts), and media URLs. Run metadata (scrape timestamp, queries, mode, total item count) is stored as a JSON record in the default key-value store.

results.title: Scraped posts
results.description: All posts scraped for the given queries. With the default 'compat' outputSchema, each item has post_id, shortcode, post_url, text, timestamp, user (id, username, full_name, profile_url, is_verified, follower_count), likes, replies, reposts, quotes, reshares, views, images, videos, is_reply, and source (plus a comments array when includeComments is enabled). With outputSchema 'clockworks', each item instead matches clockworks/tiktok-scraper's field names (id, text, createTime/createTimeISO, webVideoUrl, diggCount/shareCount/playCount/collectCount/commentCount/repostCount, hashtags, authorMeta, videoMeta, etc.) for drop-in compatibility with red-pharmatiq-api.

runMetadata.title: Run metadata
runMetadata.description: JSON record with scraped_at (ISO timestamp), queries (list of scraped queries/search terms), mode (search, hashtag, or profile), and total_items (number of items pushed to the dataset).
